phases.name: Oracle Expert Retention
phases.purpose: Measure the theoretical upper bound of expert-management improvement and the recoverable margin relative to current Argine and standard baselines.

phases.name: Routing Characterization
phases.purpose: Determine whether expert routing exhibits exploitable temporal structure.

phases.name: Working-Set Prediction
phases.purpose: Build causal predictors and determine whether prediction can improve actual runtime behaviour.

R2-01.name: Oracle Trace Contract and Replay Validation
R2-01.purpose: Establish a deterministic trace/replay contract suitable for offline retention-policy evaluation and validate that the replay preserves the information required for later oracle analysis.

R2-02.name: Oracle vs Retention Baselines
R2-02.purpose: Compare, at minimum, current Argine retention behaviour, LRU, LFU, and the offline oracle.

R2-03.name: Expert-Memory Budget Sensitivity
R2-03.purpose: Measure how the oracle/baseline gap changes under multiple expert-memory budgets.

R2-04.name: Recoverable-Margin Analysis
R2-04.purpose: Quantify the theoretical performance margin available to improved retention.

R2-05.name: Expert Frequency and Concentration
R2-05.purpose: Characterize expert access frequency and routing concentration across layers and workloads.

R2-06.name: Routing Transition Structure
R2-06.purpose: Characterize temporal transition structure in expert routing.

R2-07.name: Reuse Distance and Working-Set Structure
R2-07.purpose: Characterize reuse distance and effective working-set structure of expert accesses.

R2-08.name: Routing Drift and Workload Dependence
R2-08.purpose: Characterize how routing structure drifts over time and across workloads.

R2-09.name: Prediction Benchmark
R2-09.purpose: Define the offline benchmark and metrics for working-set prediction.

R2-10.name: Causal Working-Set Predictor
R2-10.purpose: Build a causal (no-future-information) predictor of the near-future expert working set.

R2-11.name: Prediction-Driven Retention
R2-11.purpose: Evaluate, in replay, whether the predictor can drive a retention policy that improves on the best static/oracle-informed baseline.

R2-12.name: Real Runtime Validation
R2-12.purpose: Validate the predictive retention result against the real runtime, not only in replay.
